source.title: BETA MASTER — Community Clout Championship v1: one verified event bridge, fair daily/weekly/quarterly/annual ranks, permanent 365-day Moonpet (NO DRIFT)
source.body:
# BETA MASTER PLAN — Community Clout Championship v1 (16 October 2026)

> **STATUS: SPEC / ISSUE ONLY. NOT IMPLEMENTED, NOT LIVE, NO MERGE/DEPLOY AUTHORIZATION.**
> **Owner decision:** GK delegated selection of the best *next build design* for the private/community beta. Primary goal is enjoyable **24/7 engagement and online clout**, **not money**. The task authorized here is to document the plan and dependencies. Do **not** create a PR, change main, migrate production D1, deploy Workers/Pages/VPS, change Telegram menus/secrets, enable cash/token/real-world prizes, or silently rewrite existing award rules just because this issue exists.
>
> **Scope owner:** this issue owns the **cross-ecosystem Clout receipt adapter + competition projection and UX**, *not* game engines, Moonpet economy, Arcade accuracy, GK Radio event builder, Dead Run campaign expansion, wiki lore, or existing currency ledgers.

## 0. Why this issue / outcome

A private community should be able to play whenever it wants, switch activities during game-specific cooldowns, and compete for badges, status and bragging rights. Make a **single understandable, auditable, non-spendable championship** across eligible Moonpet, Telegram, website and Arcade activities **without flattening distinct existing XP systems or rewarding fake browser numbers**.

**The chosen product model:** Moonpet's **permanent, approximately one-year Legendary journey is the long-term achievement anchor**. Shorter competitions are **daily (UTC), weekly (ISO/Monday UTC), quarterly (Moonpet competition calendar), and annual (UTC calendar year)**. The user's same pet continues across every competition reset. Nobody must already own a Moonpet to enter daily/weekly Clout.

**This is deliberately NOT a casino/bank-grade rebuild.** Reuse Cloudflare D1/Workers, signed Telegram identity and current source receipts. Protect rankings against easy farming and duplicate claims, but keep unlimited *gameplay* and reasonable budgets. Do not build new realtime infrastructure, alternate accounts, wallet/currency or a massive event bus.

## 1. Mandatory existing issue map — avoid duplicate agents and precedence drift

| Issue | Existing owner/intent | This issue MUST do | This issue MUST NOT do |
|---|---|---|---|
| **#1513** — MASTER 14 Oct build plan | A01 shot accuracy, A02 Best Run/Overall & daily/weekly Arcade competitions, A03 GK Radio host events; B02 Points/Rewards Guide, B11 likes QA; Dead Run DR01–DR14 | Consume **verified source receipts** when their child PRs ship; link status/dependencies; agree on normalized source metadata | Rebuild accuracy, host dashboard, new Dead Run modes, or overwrite #1513 decisions |
| **#1478** — MoonPet master roadmap | Moonpet UX/economy/content, Hxx provenance, existing 7 daily missions / weekly Journey / 365-day progression | Use existing accepted Moonpet event, Crest, Growth Mark, Contract, completion and quarter evidence | Add pet gameplay, change costs, delete/retire pets, merge weekly/daily Journeys, restart old Hxx work |
| **#903** — Production HUD + Arcade OS | Shared navigation/identity/proof-event presentation and cross-game UX architecture | Put Championship Clout into existing HUD/System Hub shell and central player identity | Create a rival shell, duplicate nav, bespoke unrelated game HUDs |
| **#1458** — CANON LOCK | Lore/product authority and W81 continuity | Preserve current canon and distinguish in-game clout from crypto/real-world rewards | Change lore/rights/economic promises |
| **#1259 / #1266** — NBG London prototype/art | NBG presentation and asset pipeline | Consume NBG replay-verified records once safe; preserve XP-coins-as-game-clout intent | Modify art or inject wallet XP by inference |
| **#1069** — Telegram Kaiju group | Future group match/queue & source-owned rewards | Define an extension point for later verified group-match receipt | Ship new Kaiju group mode |
| **#1071 / #1072** — World War / Plague | Future persistent faction/strategy simulations | Leave event schema extensible for future game sources | Implement those games or import unapproved reward values |
| **#1226 / #1253** — Moonpet beta audit and production verification | Preserve current-game integrity and real signed-in evidence | Reference when touching pet outputs; re-test any source integration | Assume old open findings are still bugs or already shipped |
| **#1202** (closed) | Historical 90-day Moonpet-era plan | Treat as superseded where current runtime differs | Restore obsolete 90-day pet retirement, older unlock prices or 60/10 Legendary gates |
| **#843** (closed) | Wiki likes/citation/comment missions | Reuse current source-backed awards; add true page/citation validation if used for championship | Reimplement wiki mission wiring |

Reference issue links: #1513, #1478, #903, #1458, #1259, #1266, #1069, #1071, #1072, #1226, #1253, #1202, #843. **The master issues stay open.** Child PRs must cross-link exactly which work they consume or defer. Recent issue comment claims/old PR snapshots are not proof of today's deployed versions.

## 2. Audited code baseline (revalidate before ANY implementation)

Source snapshot observed from default main on 2026-10-16: **2777337b6d7a0124483aec5a1843068b323a166c**. Source evidence != production Worker/D1/Telegram signed-in QA.

| Existing source | What code currently establishes | Integration status |
|---|---|---|
| workers/moonboys-api/pets/content/evolutions.json; pets/season-completion.js | Final Legendary stage **365 ownership days, 240 distinct-day Growth Marks, 44 distinct-week Crests**, plus level/boss/relic/material gates. Earlier age gates 7/28/84/182. Completion marker durable. | **Reuse unchanged** |
| pets/ownership-period.js; pets/season-authority.js | Pet lifetime journey continues after creation quarter; **competition quarters are calendar Jan–Mar/Apr–Jun/Jul–Sep/Oct–Dec**. Pet/source identity never resets on competition rollover. | **Reuse unchanged** |
| pets/weekly-journey.js; pets/daily-moon-run.js | Weekly 5/5 and Daily 3/5 evidence derived from accepted pet gameplay events, not direct client mission increments. | **Preferred verified sources** |
| pets/leaderboard.js | Pet daily/weekly accepted Pet XP; quarter Account Season XP; all-time retained pet XP; run-depth specialist board. | **Read-only comparison, do not replace** |
| workers/moonboys-api/community-xp-awards.js | Atomic, idempotent Community XP award receipts and active Community-season credit. | **Do not duplicate as Clout currency** |
| workers/moonboys-api/routes/dead-run.js | Server-settled ranked Dead Run results, separate local player XP and Arcade wallet settlement; GPS risk checks; daily/all boards. | **Verified-with-limitations candidate; do not conflate raw game XP with Community XP** |
| workers/leaderboard/nbg-london-records.js, nbg-london-replay.js | Run start/finish replay verification and per-period game XP; current finish increments total_xp/run_count while prize eligibility queries trusted_xp/verified_run_count. | **Pilot only after replay-reuse and period trust parity tests** |
| workers/leaderboard/deployment-entry.js | NBG prize settlement remains CODE-LOCKED independently of ranked score saving. | **Do not flip prize flags** |
| workers/leaderboard-worker.js; js/arcade-sync.js | Eight standard Arcade games have linked Telegram score submission but server does **not** recompute the actual played score. Meta score submission accepts client figures. Aggregate sums incomparable raw best scores and uses top-100 per-game lists. | **Historical/display-only until a trusted receipt exists** |
| workers/moonboys-api/worker.js | /arcade/progression/sync derives Community/Arcade XP from client raw_score/meta_points after signed Telegram auth, cooldown and rate checks; /faction/earn, /faction/signal/contribute, /player/mastery/update and /player/daily-missions/progress accept client-declared contributions/progress. | **Do not treat as independent Clout authority** |
| worker.js wiki engagement | Linked comments/likes/citation votes can award per-page daily Community XP through source evidence, but accepted page_id/cite_id are not consistently checked against canonical published inventory. | **Clout only after authentic source validation** |
| docs/moonpet-source-of-truth.md | Newer permanent-pet year-long model | **Authority for pets** |
| docs/pet-game-seasonal-model.md, docs/moonpet-season-economy-calibration.md | Some earlier passages still say 90 days / 60 Growth Marks / 10 Crests | **Stale-doc reconciliation needed; never change current runtime to match old copy** |

Pre-change audit must classify every source **EXISTS / PARTIAL / MISSING / LIVE BUG / NEEDS DESIGN / VERIFIED IN PROD** with code path, exact deployed build, signed Telegram test and the authoritative receipt/table. *A passing fixture is not a verified real player run.*

## 3. LOCKED product/canon invariants (hard fail if violated)

1. **Moonpet permanence:** same pet_id, original ownership season, earned XP, level, evolutions, 240 Marks, 44 Crests, lifetime completion, identities, spaces and saved reward receipts persist across UTC days, weeks, competition quarters and years. No quarterly pet reset/retirement. Keep 1,000 **lifetime earned Arcade XP** first-pet entry gate (not spent); max 3 active pet spaces; existing 500 / 1,000 **spendable Arcade XP** additional-space costs; preserve grandfathered owned/history rows.
2. **Never merge currencies:** Arcade lifetime/spendable XP, Community XP/telegram_users.xp, Pet XP, Block Topia XP, Faction XP/Clout, Moon Gold/Crystals/Gems, Style Tokens, game raw score, and new **Championship Clout** are distinct. UI must name each. Nothing silently converts one to another or assumes that all game XP must be the same balance.
3. **Championship Clout is NON-SPENDABLE STATUS ONLY:** no cash, crypto, NFTs with promised value, withdrawal, transferable balance, store prices, player-to-player trade, pet-slot purchases, real-money equivalents, or bridge to existing Arcade spendable wallet. Rewards v1 are visible badges, champion titles, profile honors, event shout-outs and annual Hall of Fame **only**.
4. **Do not confuse existing Battle Chamber faction clout** with the new player Championship Clout. Different owner, source table/API/UI label, rank and reconciliation. Do not feed faction totals from arbitrary browser signals.
5. **24/7 participation:** do not hard-stop game access for hitting a leaderboard threshold. Existing per-source XP caps, care timers, safety restrictions and ranked eligibility remain until a separately reviewed balancing PR. Endless practice remains available; only count distinct qualifying official championship evidence, not every refresh/click.
6. **Verified linked identity:** use signed Telegram credentials and authoritative link checks for permanent rank. Guests can play and see public boards, but do not gain permanent competitive Clout. No forced Telegram location/GPS permission for general participation.
7. **No retroactive laundering:** a historic browser score, locally saved mission, old KV rank or unverified submission is not silently promoted into verified Clout. Preserve it with a clear legacy/practice source label until independently validated.
8. **No broad rollout by one PR.** No Worker deployment, D1 migration, bot menu change or score/payment flag change without explicit release checkpoint after review and tests.

## 4. Separate time scales: Moonpet JOURNEY vs Community COMPETITION

| Plane | Window/owner | Resets | Must not reset |
|---|---|---|---|
| Permanent Moonpet Journey | Pet-specific age from recorded adoption; roughly **365 days minimum** | **Never** | pet ownership/history, 240 daily Marks, 44 weekly Crests, XP, evolutions, achievements |
| Daily Championship | 00:00:00–next 00:00:00 **UTC** | Daily board | pet/day receipts, currencies, weekly/season/annual history |
| Weekly Championship | **Monday 00:00 UTC–next Monday** | ISO week board | underlying receipts and pet progression |
| Quarterly Championship | **Calendar quarter UTC** (Q1 Jan–Mar etc.), matching current Moonpet competition quarters | Quarter board | lifetime pet journey and independent legacy 90-day Arcade boards |
| Annual Hall of Fame | UTC Jan 1–Dec 31 | Annual leaderboard (archive winners) | lifetime profile awards/history |
| Existing Arcade 90-day windows | Anchor 2024-01-01; distinct from calendar quarter | Existing legacy schedule stays initially | **Do not repurpose or silently move existing stored boards** |
| Existing Community Season | Configured active telegram_seasons dates | Existing authority stays initially | all-time Community XP |
| Moonpet Weekly Journey | Per-pet creation-week clock, not always ISO week | Objective period only | previously earned pet Crest/evidence |

**Decision:** NEW Championship Clout quarter follows Moonpet calendar quarters; **do not change pre-existing Arcade or Community season authorities in this issue**. Show any differing period dates visibly. A later separately approved normalization/migration may replace legacy boards only after archived snapshots and proof.

For source-to-Championship attribution, default to immutable **server-earned timestamp** of the qualifying source event, not request-supplied time or retry time. Preserve each existing source's documented exception if its original receipt uses a settled period. Apply a single normalized UTC interval calculation inside the new Clout projector; prevent backdating, forward dating, late-insert rank movement after final freeze except explicit audited corrections. Publish exact board end and claim-freeze rules.

## 5. Selected fair *v1* scoring model — simple, small-audience-friendly

**Do not sum raw scores across Snake, NBG, Dead Run, Kaiju, Moonpet etc.** Different games have incomparable numerical ranges. A 100,000-point easy score must not defeat a technically difficult 3,000-point score simply due to scale.

**Championship Clout daily budget: 100 possible non-spendable ranking points from proven actions** (this is a competition scoring formula, NOT a cap on gameplay, earned Pet XP or shared Arcade XP):

| Bucket | Up to | Calculation / source policy |
|---|---:|---|
| **Skill** | **40** | The best **up to 3 distinct eligible games** that day. Game-specific server-verified performance maps to a versioned 0–100 skill rating. **Monotonic v1 rule:** Skill Clout = floor(40 × min(100, best_verified_rating + 0.10 × second_best_rating + 0.05 × third_best_rating) / 100), with missing games contributing zero. A newcomer with only one title can still earn the full 40; playing a weaker second game can NEVER reduce existing Clout. Keep only the best verified rating per title. No repeat-run sum. |
| **Daily/Weekly mission evidence** | **25** | Server-defined mission IDs and target definitions. Mission completion credits only if owned source event(s) qualify; daily objectives and once-per-week journey proof. Allocate exact points by public policy registry, not client target/amount. |
| **Variety / activity switching** | **15** | Three 5-point unique eligible categories or games within the UTC day (requires at least one **verified completed** action for each). Rotation should not require paid features or location permissions. |
| **Community engagement** | **10** | First approved/valid linked engagement actions, e.g. legitimate wiki like/comment/citation or bot daily claim, with daily dedupe and canonical page/citation verification. Not points-per-page, arbitrary votes, browsing seconds or spammable comments. |
| **Streak / scheduled event** | **10** | Server-backed attendance across distinct days and/or official scheduled event proof. No idle-online timer rewards; missed day cannot mint an invented proof. Event score overrides require an explicit approved rule. |

**TOTAL** = integer 0–100 daily Championship Clout. Daily board compares this day's total. Weekly = sum of its distinct official UTC days; quarterly = sum of its days; yearly = sum of its days. Retain underlying event evidence, but materialize small derived period totals for cheap reads. Duplicate syncs cannot increase the daily score, replays/returns cannot consume multiple slots, and points may only increase after server-verified improvement of an eligible best result until a period closes. For a tiny player base, use **fixed/versioned per-game skill thresholds and minimal valid gameplay**, not raw live-percentiles that wildly fluctuate with 2–5 participants.

**Tie breakers:** higher verified total; then more distinct eligible gameplay titles in period; then more verified active days; then earliest final qualifying server timestamp; then stable verified Telegram ID. The source policy version and actual tie rules must be stored with the archived board. A private test cohort must verify fairness before production activation.

This is the **default non-economic Championship formula selected for beta build planning**. Numbers may be tuned from sample gameplay, but never silently during an active competition. Commit a named immutable policy version and apply scoring changes at **next period boundary** (or explicitly announce/archive a beta reset). Economy impacts outside this non-spendable Clout ledger still require #1513/#1478 authorization.

Keep separate existing **Best Run / Overall / Accuracy** specialist boards from #1513 A01/A02. This 0–100 Clout championship is an additional *cross-game* layer, not an alternative accuracy implementation.

## 6. Verified source registry (authoritative eligibility matrix)

Each adapter MUST read a **server-owned immutable event/receipt**, prove the linked owner and a real qualifying outcome, and declare its verification class. First release should prioritize sources that already have receipts.

| Source | Provenance/adapter requirement | Initial Clout disposition |
|---|---|---|
| **Moonpet care, Daily Journey, Weekly Journey** | Accepted telegram_pet_events + source pet_id, owner, saved day/week/season; read Growth Mark/Crest unique awards where relevant. Per-pet week is not ISO Clout week. | **First pilot**: mission/variety, never raw Pet XP → raw Clout |
| **Moonpet Contracts / bosses / final Legendary** | Verified saved completed run / boss result / permanent progression receipt; no reward on failure/abandon. Year-long Legendary success is permanent Hall of Fame honor; optional one-off quarterly recognition. | **First pilot** for receipt-backed completions; preserve existing unlimited Contract *plays* |
| **Telegram /daily** | Existing awardCommunityXp daily_claim once-per-UTC-day receipt; accepted and linked. | **First pilot** in small engagement budget; does NOT grant 1,000 Arcade XP |
| **Website wiki interactions** | Genuine signed linked user, real published page registry + actual citation ID; moderation/validity and unique source receipt. No fictional page_id/cite_id spam. | **After page/citation validity gate**, limited engagement credit |
| **Dead Run** | Active server-ended ranked session, settled score and verified movement/action evidence, one best qualifying result per title/day. Handle spoofable GPS cautiously; optional game, never mandatory for broad Clout. | **Next pilot after abuse/sync tests** |
| **NBG London** | Saved replay-verified run, server-computed XP/time, finish receipt; ensure input replay cannot be trivially reused for fresh receipts, and reconcile trusted_xp/verified_run_count vs total_xp/run_count before any *prize* logic. | **Next pilot after replay-reuse regression**; NBG game XP remains game metric |
| **Eight main Arcade games** | Game runtime acceptance + independent challenge/run proof or server-signed single-use trusted source receipt. Telegram auth alone and a submitted high score do not prove play. | **Read legacy boards; NO new official Championship points** until their individual proof adapters pass |
| **Block Topia Street Signal independent board** | Separate KV leaderboard; signed identity != server-verified skill. Require genuine run authority; no double credit for the same Arcade action. | **Not eligible initially** |
| **Faction contributions / faction XP / player mastery / generic daily progress APIs** | Currently accept client numbers in important routes. Cannot use as Championship source without verifiable upstream events; do not infer official receipts from acceptance alone. | **Excluded until secured or strictly derived** |
| **Future #1069 Kaiju group / #1071–#1072 World War/Plague / #1513 events** | Provider owns match/event settlement and emits immutable result ID; Clout reads and validates. | **Interface only**, no gameplay implementation here |

**Source definitions must include:** source system, source event type, canonical owner ID, accepted state, durable event ID, first earned timestamp, verifier version, rule/policy version, source score/metric, optional pet_id, source season key, provider's receipt/cap semantics, Clout categories it may qualify for, invalidation state and audit reference. No session-token or Telegram secrets in public Clout rows.

Do not reinterpret verified Moonpet XP as Arcade XP, or Dead Run's game-local XP as Community XP. Existing Community and Arcade balances continue behaving under their own contracts.

## 7. Lightweight D1 Championship event bridge (not a replacement game engine)

**Recommended implementation:** one additive, minimal, append-only Championship source-claim table + daily/weekly/quarterly/annual projections in current production D1. Exact SQL is a child PR deliverable after inspecting existing schemas and migration numbering. No new KV or queue unless measured.

Required properties:

- Unique authoritative key **(source_system, source_event_id, owner_telegram_id, policy_version, qualifying_effect)** or equivalent fixed natural key. A retry returns the same verdict; no double Clout or duplicated badge.
- Worker recomputes score effects from a **D1 source receipt/approved provider record**, checks account ownership + anti-cheat, status and real window; browser payload is a *request for synchronization*, never a clout_delta/mission_target/raw score source.
- If effect maps to multiple declared buckets, separate effect keys make each explicit and idempotent; same source may satisfy a mission AND skill policy where documented, not multiplied arbitrarily.
- For counters/bests store source identity, policy_version, validated score and maximum eligible best. Corrections/revocations must be explicit, audited and recalculated atomically; prevent unordered replay regressions.
- An accepted source receipt and Championship effect must commit atomically **where one D1 writer owns both**, or use read-and-claim with a guarded exactly-once projection where the event already committed. Fail closed on missing/unavailable source, partial row or banned identity.
- Batch/D1 uniqueness protects simultaneous different devices. Store audit timestamp and original source timestamp. Preserve past periods; never delete old score rows or retroactively re-award spendable XP.
- Aggregations must read D1 indexed by (period_type, period_key, telegram_id) or preaggregate deterministically; avoid reading every game history on each public page view. Keep leaderboard queries cheap for a small community; cache public reads briefly only if invalidated/TTL clearly defined.
- No per-frame server calls, constant re-polling, daily N×users cron or long-running database scans. Include inexpensive recovery/reconciliation for interrupted one-off projections.

**API contract (names illustrative, review existing route collisions before choosing):**
- GET public/current Championship season metadata with UTC reset deadlines and policy version.
- GET public daily/weekly/quarterly/annual board with ranking basis, source status, player name and no sensitive IDs.
- POST linked /me or state read with signed Telegram proof; returns eligible sources, current verified Clout, badges and next available suggestions.
- Optional POST sync for a *reference to an existing authoritative receipt only*; no direct award, score, claim amount, or mission target field.
- Admin-only archive/recompute/audit endpoints only if genuinely necessary; do not expose a client-settable admin/manual top-up.

## 8. Repair obvious competition-write authority weaknesses — SCOPE / compatibility

**Before an official source is eligible**, address or isolate these current endpoints. Preserve existing client compatibility and historical balances; do not zero wallets or withdraw rank without a transparent beta provenance policy.

- workers/leaderboard-worker.js POST score + meta: accepts verified Telegram identity but client-provided score/meta/timestamp; does not attest to actual completed gameplay. Do not count those rows as verified Championship Clout, even when returning accepted=true.
- workers/moonboys-api/worker.js POST /arcade/progression/sync: validates auth and anti-farm/caps, but accepts raw_score, meta_points and client_run_id; these are not official proof. Restrict new competitive authority to server-issued receipt, migrate clients safely; do not suddenly strand legitimate current players.
- worker.js /faction/earn, /faction/signal/contribute, /player/mastery/update and /player/daily-missions/progress: browser-supplied numbers can alter standings/claims. Make Championship rewards derive only from **actual source actions**. Separate current/future security remediation for legacy systems with regression coverage.
- workers/blocktopia-leaderboard/worker.js: independent score API also accepts signed user-declared score; preserve its existing specialist board but do not mark as proof without a trusted game source.
- NBG: no switch enabling prizes based solely on flags; verify replay uniqueness, period trust fields, and full real-browser run before integrating. Keep NBG_LONDON_PRIZES_RELEASED false until separate explicit sign-off (and decide whether any old spendable XP prize model is being retired in favor of badge-only competition).
- Website wiki: validate real page/citation catalogs and approved linked action before rewarding Clout. Existing wiki 10 Community XP mission rule is separate and should not silently change.

**Anti-cheat proportionate to private beta:** unique source receipts, signed owner, realistic per-game proof where needed, minimum gameplay duration/action evidence, no score timestamps from client, diminishing rank effect for repeated easy events, manual moderator review for abuse. Do **not** add costly fraud vendors, complex real-time telemetry for every game, IP-derived identities, forced GPS, or punitive global XP wipes. Record suspected fraudulent/unverified separately, and allow appeals/corrections.

## 9. Retention loop and UX (24/7 engagement, not compulsory online timers)

Player-facing loop: **play eligible game → saved/verified result → daily mission + Clout credits → visible next action during cooldown → weekly/quarterly progress → badge/Hall of Fame**.

- One daily "Today's Clout" widget on existing System Hub / Games / Moonpet Missions summary / Telegram bot entry, not four competing HUDs. Link through existing site-shell (issue #903). No new duplicate navigation.
- Give **three server-selected daily objectives** across available activities, and weekly goals, but do **not** replace Moonpet's 7/7 checklist, 3/5 Daily Journey, 5/5 Weekly Journey, Moonpet bounties, or #1513's planned shooting accuracy missions. Use one qualifying-event registry and display exactly which already-existing objective it also satisfies.
- During a Moonpet cooldown, recommend the next eligible available action from *current server cooldown and receipt state* (e.g., Arcade title, NBG, wiki, Moonpet Contracts, another allowed pet activity), and show exact cost/eligibility/claim/no-claim, reset countdown. An unavailable app or GPS-only mode never blocks all progress.
- Continue to let players play after XP caps: explain "practice / verified result / XP at cap / Clout best already counted / next reset" instead of hiding the game or promising unlimited awards.
- UI states: **practice only**, **verified**, **saved**, **already counted**, **awaiting verification**, **not eligible**, **blocked**, **unavailable/retry**. Never label stale localStorage preview as "live". Keep full reward/history semantics.
- Responsive 360px/390px and desktop; readable color-independent rank/status, keyboard/Telegram mini-app navigation, short polling, offline fallback. Public anonymous scoreboard reads only. No token/precise GPS exposure.
- One shared "How Points Work" source-of-truth guide is **already owned by #1513 B02**. Supply this issue's Clout formula and reason codes as inputs; do not create a competing guide route.
- Event or accuracy UI from #1513 A01–A03 should reuse this projection interface **once shipped**, without double counting or bypassing its existing organizer/moderator gates.

## 10. Delivery: small independent PRs, in this sequence

### PR 0 — Evidence/contract and beta decisions (NO production mutation)
- [ ] Rebase on current main; read AGENTS.md, #1513, #1478, #903, #1458 and both Moonpet current docs; reconcile stale 90-day/60/10 statements against current 365/240/44 runtime before modifying public copy.
- [ ] Audit actual D1 schema, receipt ownership, Worker flags/deployed version, current player-visible boards, representative new + returning signed Telegram test account (do not expose identifiers).
- [ ] Publish source eligibility table with **EXISTS/PARTIAL/MISSING/LIVE BUG/NEEDS DESIGN/VERIFIED IN PROD**, route proof, count/window semantics, code and screenshot references.
- [ ] Record final approved Clout v1 weights/eligibility and no-financial-prize commitment; reserve unique API/table names avoiding faction clout collisions. **No gameplay code in this PR.**

### PR 1 — Additive Championship Clout ledger + deterministic read-only projector
- [ ] Versioned source registry, reusable receipt-validation helper, single-use effect keys, D1 uniqueness, small source/period indexes, dry-run policy calculator, public scoring contract.
- [ ] UTC day/week/calendar-quarter/year buckets, active/current + archived leaderboard reads, tie breakers, deterministic reload and idempotent backfill **only of explicitly validated** historic evidence (prefer start-from-launch for ranking; grandfather old records as legacy-visible).
- [ ] Migration preflight, compatibility and rollback test; **do not apply production migration inside PR**. No Arcade/Moonpet XP rate changes.

### PR 2 — Verified core pilot, available to newcomers without a pet
- [ ] Server-receipt integration: existing Telegram /daily claim; Moonpet accepted Daily/Weekly Journey/Contracts/verified boss or milestone sources; genuine validated wiki sources (after page/citation guard).
- [ ] Feature flag; include a non-Moonpet participation path (linked Telegram action + eligible wiki) for players below the 1,000 lifetime Arcade XP adoption gate.
- [ ] Live test duplicate awards, switch pet, old-quarter claim and same source across missions; no interference with 3 pet slots, wallet or existing 7/7 and 3/5 and 5/5 counters.

### PR 3 — Trusted scored games (separate source adapters, NOT rewrites)
- [ ] NBG: one-replay-per-accepted-run tests, prevent cheap reused input sequences; period trust-field parity; read-only existing game boards preserved; **no spendable prize payout**.
- [ ] Dead Run: true ranked/final settled source; best-per-player metric projection; no GPS requirement to participate in the broader Championship; no duplicate XP or spurious Community XP conversion.
- [ ] Main eight-game Arcade + independent Block Topia: adapters only when real run verification/receipt issuance exists; coordinate directly with #1513 A01/A02 rather than independently implementing it.
- [ ] Each source has explicit enabled/disabled status. Do not fake a combined board from client-submitted numbers while adapters are incomplete.

### PR 4 — Clout leaderboards, badges, Hall of Fame and cooldown-aware guidance
- [ ] Present compact daily/weekly/quarterly/annual standings and rank basis, "My Clout" break-down, badge/titles, period end/reset and history.
- [ ] Keep specialist Moonpet/NBG/DeadRun/Arcade ranks; don't hide old boards. No double labels "XP" for non-spendable Clout.
- [ ] Cooldown-specific next action using existing server states; clear Claim/Recorded/Unverified notices, don't reward screen time or page reloads.
- [ ] Coordinate shared HUD with #903; guide with #1513 B02; Moonpet menus with #1478; no competing menu/framework.

### PR 5 — Production verification, canary and controlled activation
- [ ] Run existing domain CI, issue-required targeted regressions, D1 SQLite concurrency/rollback tests, Worker+Pages provenance checks, 360px/390px/desktop browser tests, real signed Telegram new/returning account smoke.
- [ ] Backup & record current D1 + KV/score history; deploy migration only after reviewed PR and **before** matching Worker; stage/read-only flags first; activate pilot only after explicit GK release approval.
- [ ] Check live accumulation/rollover at UTC day, ISO week, calendar quarter, leap year, year end; old pet and legacy Arcade 90-day windows remain intact.
- [ ] Observe lightweight error logs, reconcile 3 sample verified user journeys, verify no unexpected Arcade spendable or Community XP award, publish rollback strategy and what has/has not been released.
- [ ] Add links to child PRs and production evidence here; keep this issue open until GK confirms all selected phases or deliberately defers any remaining adapters.

**Parallel work:** agents may work independently on issue inventory/tests or per-game adapter design, but one designated owner coordinates the **D1 schema + shared reward authority**. Any two PRs touching the same Worker route/ledger must sequence through review; no simultaneous competing migration or direct edits to main.

## 11. Acceptance tests (must be executable, not checkbox theatre)

### Trust/abuse
- [ ] Browser sends invented million-XP or forged meta and claims a fresh client ID: **zero new Championship Clout**, no extra Community/Arcade XP or faction power.
- [ ] Repeat exact source event 100 times, across browser sessions and concurrent requests: exactly **one** effect per declared category; stored period total unchanged by repeats.
- [ ] Different Telegram account submits another account's run/pet/mission receipt: rejected; no cross-account membership or pet ownership leakage.
- [ ] Tampered mission ID, target, amount, fake game score, fake date, stale/expired Telegram link: cannot mint Clout.
- [ ] Nonexistent published-page slug or nonexistent citation ID cannot generate wiki Championship Clout.
- [ ] No signed identity: public boards visible; no permanent score mutations.
- [ ] Rate-limit and ban-state unavailability fail closed; corrected score/ban status supports audited rollback/recalculation without double points.

### Gameplay fairness
- [ ] Heavy player repeats one easy action 1,000 times: can still play; no unlimited new daily Championship points.
- [ ] Skilled player with one verified game qualifies and can place; variety bonus rewards diversity without requiring Moonpet/GPS/paid item.
- [ ] Two games with vastly different native point scales produce comparable **versioned normalized** skill values.
- [ ] Moonpet lifetime and all event receipts survive a quarter boundary; daily/weekly/Crest/Mark attribution follows original source time, not delayed retry time.
- [ ] A non-Moonpet newcomer can join and rank, while the 1,000 lifetime Arcade XP pet-entry gate stays unchanged.
- [ ] Moonpet year-long Legendary remains 365/240/44; after quarterly reset the same pet retains all Marks/Crests/evolution, achievements and optional future annual Hall of Fame.
- [ ] Existing NBG gameplay score can be saved without enabling its spendable Arcade prize cron; duplicate/reused replay does not create new eligible prize proof.
- [ ] Dead Run independently credited Arcade wallet remains unchanged; no new Community XP is silently added just from displaying Clout.
- [ ] Legacy unverified Arcade/meta score stays visible in existing specialist boards, but does not become "verified" Championship score without a source event.

### Calendar/UX and budget
- [ ] Day 23:59:59.999 UTC vs 00:00:00.000, week Sunday→Monday, Mar31→Apr1, Dec31→Jan1, source earned-at vs delayed claim all allocate to documented periods with stable ties.
- [ ] 2-user and 10-user boards behave sensibly (no live population percentile instability); stable top-three/badge snapshots settle once.
- [ ] Same action contributes at most its declared effects to Clout, missions and faction proof; no accidental "triple Community XP".
- [ ] On cooldown, shown alternative action is actually eligible when tapped; server remains final authority; no forced online screen-time grind.
- [ ] No duplicate NAV or pages, infinite timers, per-frame API traffic, D1 full history scan per public GET, novel vendor/billing dependency, or leaking private Telegram/GPS data.
- [ ] UI explains precisely when counts are practice, verified, already counted, inactive or waiting for the next UTC reset.

## 12. Release and handoff protocol (all agents MUST follow)

For every child issue/PR post a short status comment **to THIS issue** using:

~~~text
Work package: PR N / source ID(s) / overlaps #1513 Axx Bxx DRxx, #1478 Hxx
Current main SHA; Worker/Pages provenance; prod D1 migration ledger status:
Status: EXISTS | PARTIAL | MISSING | LIVE BUG | NEEDS DESIGN | VERIFIED IN PROD
Authoritative source row + receipt ID type + owner + UTC period:
Exact game/API/DB/JS files touched:
In scope / out of scope and canonical rules preserved:
Fraud/replay/double-award/clock/cross-account tests:
Test commands + observed results; CI run links:
New D1 migrations? backup/apply/ledger order:
Worker deploy? Pages deploy? VPS? Telegram menu?:
Live signed Telegram verification and actual result (or UNVERIFIED):
Economic/score-policy change? Approved source issue / decision:
Rollback + old balance/history preservation:
Open conflicts / next work package:
~~~

Mandatory repository checks: AGENTS.md, current CI workflow and the correct Worker runbooks. Workflows/PR labels don't prove production deployed. Changes that touch Arcade XP, Moonpet Gold/costs, faction influence, prizes or legacy score calculation require the separate approval/QA required by #1513/#1478. Do not change protected wiki lore or brand canon under #1458.

**Agent STOP conditions:** missing source-owner proof; unclear currency vs Clout scope; D1 migration not on current migration head; reward/period ambiguity; read failure being treated as zero; missing real Telegram auth; conflicting PR touching same Worker; changes to permanent pet lifecycle, pet-entry/slot costs, 90-day legacy ranking, live spendable XP payout or new real-value reward. Stop, annotate here, and request a narrowly scoped decision. Do not invent a resolution.

## 13. Definition of done

- [ ] At least newcomer/Telegram + genuine Moonpet + one server-verified scored game have **live verified** points on a single Daily/Weekly/Quarterly/Annual non-spendable Championship Clout board; unsupported game adapters show honest "not yet verified".
- [ ] Cross-game source event dedupe, one-owner proof, fair normalized skill, clock/freeze and history-preserving rollback pass deterministic and signed production smoke tests.
- [ ] Moonpet 365-day Legendary path (240/44) and quarter-competition separation stay intact; zero lost/duplicated Pet XP, Arcade XP, Community XP, wallet balances, Marks, Crests or pets.
- [ ] No non-economic Clout points leak into spendable Arcade XP, Gold, wallet or other in-game economies; NBG's legacy XP prize cron remains locked unless separately approved.
- [ ] Players can play 24/7, clearly understand skill/mission/community contribution and see useful available cooldown alternatives.
- [ ] No duplicated implementation of #1513, #1478, #903 or new future games; canonical guides and handover comment include exact status and final provenance.
- [ ] All child work is merged/deployed **only after review/approval**, with rollback and real signed-account results. No claims of "complete" until those steps are documented.

### Owner intent / final product definition

**One identity, distinct XP systems, one non-spendable Championship Clout ranking based on genuine saved achievements. Moonpet is the permanent year-long anchor; daily/weekly/quarterly/annual competitions reset only standings, never pets. Endless play is welcome; fake credits and score replays are not. Low-cost, small-community beta — no casino, no real-value prize system, no infrastructure overbuild.**

**This is the authoritative planning issue for the *Clout integration layer only*. Issues #1513 and #1478 remain owners of their existing gameplay and economy roadmaps.**
